change_summary: Increase structured logging sampling rate from 1% to 10% in search-service to improve debug coverage for intermittent latency spikes.
diff_or_config:
--- a/config/logging.yaml
+++ b/config/logging.yaml
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 service: search-service
 format: json
 level: info
-sampling_rate: 0.01
+sampling_rate: 0.10
 fields:
   - request_id
   - user_id
   - latency_ms
   - status_code
service_context: search-service handles 100k queries/min. Logs ship to Elasticsearch via Fluentd. Current storage: 2TB/day at 1% sampling.
deployment_plan: Feature flag gradual rollout: 5% of pods -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days.
observability_evidence: Log volume dashboard: grafana.internal/d/search-log-volume. Fluentd pipeline metrics in CloudWatch.
validation_evidence: Tested in staging with 10% sampling for 24h. No Fluentd backpressure. ES ingestion stable.

seeded_gaps.description: No rollback plan for sampling rate change
No alerting for log pipeline saturation or storage exhaustion
No SLO/reliability impact assessment for 10x log volume increase
